summary: Creates a TOP output connector on a Component so image results can be exposed outside the component network.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Hover label shown for the component output.

key_params.name: outputresolution
key_params.note: Output resolution policy for the exposed TOP image.

key_params.name: resolution
key_params.note: Explicit width and height when using custom resolution.

key_params.name: outputaspect
key_params.note: Aspect-ratio policy for the output image.

key_params.name: format
key_params.note: Pixel format for the output texture.

common_gotchas: Component outputs are positioned alphanumerically; stable naming matters when exposing multiple outputs.
Out TOP has a single input and does not create image content by itself; it exposes the incoming TOP stream.
Use the label for UI clarity, but use node names and connection order for deterministic automation.
Common TOP resolution, aspect, filtering, and pixel-format overrides can silently change the component output contract.
key_concepts: Creates a TOP output connector on a Component.
Exposes the incoming TOP stream outside the component network.
Component outputs appear on the right side in alphanumeric order.
The unique Label parameter affects hover UI while Common TOP controls define the output texture contract.
